data.gender_notes: Deepraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deep (Deepa) - vast, deep, abundant; Raj (Raja) - king, ruler. This name signifies a deep, powerful, and wise ruler. The name Deepraj carries the meaning “Deep, king” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepraj usually hope their child will grow to embody deep, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Deepraj can be seen as a reflection of these values, and may inspire those who bear this name to cultivate deep wisdom and strong leadership qualities.

Just as the name suggests, the heart and mind of a person can be deep and vast, capable of holding vast amounts of knowledge, understanding, and compassion. Ultimately, the name Deepraj can be seen as a call to tap into one's inner wisdom and strength, and to use these qualities to serve others and make a positive impact on the world.
